summary: US-022: Back-office seat-map editing UI + version history
description:
### US-022: Back-office seat-map editing UI + version history
**As** staff, **I want** to edit a published seat map, see its version history, and manage a venue's GA/seated configuration from the back office, **so that** the full author-and-edit COS is met in the UI. **Priority:** P2 **Depends on:** TKT-103, TKT-104

This rounds out the epic's 'staff can author **and edit** a seat map in the back office UI' COS on the UI side, on top of the draft authoring (TKT-102), publish (TKT-103) and safe-edit backend + pinning contract (TKT-104). RESHAPED 2026-07-20 (owner decision): this ticket ABSORBS the catalog HTTP layer that exposes TKT-104's store-only edit/pin contract (ADR-029 §5 left it to TKT-105) — new endpoints + OpenAPI + regenerated types + error mapping — in addition to the UI. It introduces NO new domain rule; it surfaces the existing TKT-104 contract via HTTP and UI and must respect the pinning contract's rejection cases in the UX.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Back-office UI: staff edit a published map, producing a new version through the TKT-104 path; the UI shows the version history for a map (which version is published, when).
- [ ] An edit the pinning contract rejects (would orphan a sold/held seat) surfaces a clear, actionable error in the UI rather than failing silently or corrupting state (screenshot in the PR).
- [ ] Staff can see and set a venue's GA vs seated configuration from the back office (GA capacity and its seat map(s) coexist and are both visible).
- [ ] The back-office consumes only published catalog contracts (ADR-009 generated types); no back-office-only backend logic that belongs in catalog.
- [ ] UI verified in a browser; storefront and scanner untouched.

**Quality gates (every story):**
- `make check` green (lint + unit + integration + smoke; mirrors CI)
- Contract tests pass for any touched service boundary (ADR-009 drift check)
- New/changed public read endpoints declare an ADR-004 TTL tier with rationale
- New migrations run out-of-band via the service `migrate` subcommand (ADR-022) and build within the 30s startup budget with plain `CREATE INDEX` (ADR-020)
- Every owned entity is `organizer_id`-scoped (ADR-002)

Parent epic: TKT-3. Full lineage: docs/product/prd-v1.md §Capability map (TKT-3).

binding.rule: Contract-first: frontends consume OpenAPI-published catalog contracts via generated types; no ad-hoc backend logic in the web app.

Every public read endpoint declares a volatility-tiered `Cache-Control`/`s-maxage`. Venue/seat-map geometry is the 'hours' tier (longer-lived than the 'minutes' event tier); availability is 'seconds'; hold/order state is never cached. Writes are never cached.

governingAdrs.why: Editing/version-history UI binds to the catalog OpenAPI contracts from TKT-102/103/104; regenerate types, don't hand-roll.
Any geometry/version reads the UI triggers are the 'hours' tier; version-history is catalog-owned, not a new back-office store.

TKT-3 epic — COS: authoring UI, versioning safe against sold inventory, GA+seated coexist
Back-office app scaffolded in TKT-101; extend it here

### 🔄 DoR RE-SHAPED — TKT-105 absorbs the catalog HTTP+regen backend (owner decision 2026-07-20)

**Why:** a pre-claim seam survey (confirmed against `services/catalog/api/openapi.yaml`, `server.go`, `store.go`, and **ADR-029 §Decision point 5** verbatim) found that TKT-104 shipped the safe-edit path and pinning contract as **store functions only — no HTTP endpoint, no OpenAPI path, no generated type**. ADR-029 §5: *“No new HTTP endpoint in this ticket. The deliverable is the contract … the editing UI is TKT-105.”* The ticket was written as UI-only (*“no new domain rules… OUT: back-office-only backend logic”*) but three of its four functional COS cannot be met without net-new catalog backend:

| COS | Missing backend | Was |
|---|---|---|
| Edit published map → new version | HTTP endpoint over `EditSeatMap` (store-only) + OpenAPI + regen | 500-mapped, no route |
| Version-history view | **net-new** store read + endpoint (nothing at any layer) | absent |
| See **and set** venue GA config | venue GA read + update endpoint (`ga_capacity` write-once) | absent |
| Surface pin-rejection cleanly | map `ErrSeatMapEditOrphansPinned`→409 in `writeStoreError` | falls through to 500 |

**Owner decision (2026-07-20):** *absorb* the backend into TKT-105 — it becomes a **full-stack ticket** owning the catalog endpoints (edit→new-version, version-history read, venue GA read+update), OpenAPI paths, regenerated Go+TS types, error mapping, **and** the UI. Owner also confirmed both optional endpoints (version-history, venue-GA-update) are **in** scope now, so the epic’s author-and-**edit** COS is met at full depth, not shallowly.

**How to apply:** `scope`, `approach`, `first_slice`, `success`, `uncertainties`, `dependencies` readiness notes updated above; the description AC block updated. It introduces **no new domain rule** (the edit/pin contract stays TKT-104’s, unchanged) — it surfaces the existing contract via HTTP+UI. Still governed by ADR-009 (contract-first, regen, drift gate) and ADR-004 (hours-tier reads). All 8 DoR items remain met/deferred; no `open owner:human` item introduced — the reshape is a scope clarification the owner directed, not a new unknown.

_Recorded pre-claim; the plan stage will design the exact endpoint shapes against the existing store signatures._

**A/B plan experiment ran — 3 arms** (config has 2; owner added a 3rd, 2026-07-20). All arms got the *same* brief (full-stack reshaped scope, 6 COS, governing ADRs, verified seams) and ran **read-only**. Cross-model invariant held: planReview = `main-agent`, distinct from every drafter.

<!-- sdlc:stage=planning kind=plan-final -->
### ✅ planReview (main-agent) + plan-final — TKT-105

**GATE 2 WAIVED (owner, gateless run).** Per ab-stages §6, I (orchestrator) stand in as the Gate-2 judge: I ran every arm, critiqued them adversarially as `planReview` (main-agent ≠ every drafter), and select the winner with stated reasons below. Every self-made decision is recorded here (gateless-run requirement).

#### planReview — adversarial critique (verified every load-bearing symbol at HEAD)
I re-grepped each disputed fact against the real code before accepting it. Verdicts:

- ✅ **`EditSeatMap`'s 2nd return is `needsEmit`, not `created`** (my brief said 'created'; **Arm A copied that error**, Arm C caught it). Confirmed `store.go:465`: *'needsEmit is true while the new version's seat_map.published event is still owed — the caller emits, then marks.'* The edit handler MUST mirror `PublishSeatMap` (server.go:1029-1050): `SeatMapPublished` → `MarkSeatMapEventEmitted`, and on emit failure return 500 naming re-POST-publish-of-the-new-version-id as recovery (NOT retry the edit — that mints another version). **ACCEPTED from Arm C.** This is a correctness-critical fix to my own brief.
- ✅ **Three generated files change, not two** — `make generate` (Makefile:29-31) also regens `web/storefront/src/lib/api-types.gen.ts` from the same catalog spec, and `check-generate` (Makefile:35-37) diffs all three. **Arm A's 2-file plan would have failed the gate.** Arm C flagged it and reconciled with COS-6 (mechanical regen ≠ storefront source change; call it out in the PR). **ACCEPTED from Arm C.**
- ✅ **`current_version` must be explicit** — an edit never mutates the predecessor, so a family accumulates multiple `status='published'` rows; 'current' = highest published version (`lockCurrentPublishedVersion` ORDER BY version DESC, postgres.go). Arm A's bare `is_current` flag was underspecified. **ACCEPTED Arm C's `SeatMapVersionHistory { current_version, versions[] }`.**
- ✅ **Reuse `GET /public/venues` for the GA read; add only a POST write** — the spec has no PUT/PATCH anywhere (publish/close/reopen are POST-actions), and `getVenue()`/`[id].astro` already surface `ga_capacity`. Arm A proposed a new `GET /public/venues/{id}` + `PATCH`. **ACCEPTED Arm C's narrower `POST /venues/{venueId}/ga-capacity`** (repo-idiomatic, fewer new endpoints).
- ✅ **`no-store` is the `writeJSON` default** (server.go:172-173) — writes need no explicit header; hours tier via `CacheControlPublicVenueReads` const. Both arms correct; Arm C more precise.
- ⚖️ **`ListVenueSeatMaps` omits `published_at`** — Arm A wanted to 'fix' the old scan; **Arm C correctly scoped it OUT** (pre-existing TKT-102 gap) and instead has the NEW `ListSeatMapVersions` select `published_at` explicitly. **ADOPTED Arm C's scoping** — don't widen this ticket into old reads.
- ✅ Edit response is **`201 Created`** (Arm C) not 200 (Arm A) — a new resource (version) is minted; matches REST + the spec's create conventions.

#### Selection — WINNER: Arm C (`fable-5`)
Arm C **strictly dominates**: it caught a correctness bug in my brief (needsEmit), a gate-breaking omission (3rd gen file), a contract subtlety (multi-published current-version), and chose the repo-idiomatic surface (POST-action, reuse-list, 201). Arm A was a solid, complete plan and its sequencing/file-table cross-checked Arm C, but on every point of disagreement Arm C was right against HEAD. **Arm C is *the* plan; planReview and Building run on it.** (Arm B/luna produced a stub, not a plan — it contributed nothing to selection; tallied as a harness failure only.)

#### Self-made decisions (gateless — recorded per run directive)
1. **Winner = Arm C**, reasons above (most-correct-against-code; the critique recommends it).
2. **GA read reuses `/public/venues`; only a POST GA-write is added** (Arm C) — most reversible / smallest new surface, and it satisfies COS-5.
3. **`ListVenueSeatMaps` `published_at` gap left unfixed** (Arm C scoping) — out of this ticket; version-history read carries the timestamps COS-3 needs.
4. **Edit endpoint returns 201**; **`ErrSeatIdentityNotFound` mapped to 409 defensively** (never 500) even though no HTTP path triggers it yet.
5. **3 generated files committed** (catalog Go, storefront TS, backoffice TS); the storefront regen is mechanical and called out in the PR as NOT a storefront source change (preserves COS-6).

#### REQUIRED: introduced at plan-review, reviewed by no second model
The cross-model guarantee covers the drafts (3 models) and the eventual code (A/B ai-review). These elements I *added/decided* at planReview are reviewed by nobody but me — flagged for the Gate-3 hand-off and extra scrutiny in ai-review:
- The **201-vs-200** choice for the edit response (my call; neither draft's exact status survived unchanged — Arm A said 200, Arm C said 201; I ratified 201).
- The **defensive 409 mapping of `ErrSeatIdentityNotFound`** (Arm A suggested 404, Arm C 409; I chose 409 — 'not in current published version' is a conflict, not a missing resource). ai-review must confirm this doesn't mask a genuine 404 case.
- Otherwise: **none** — the spine, endpoints, store reads, TDD order, and test plan are all Arm C's, already model-authored.

#### The plan (Arm C spine — governing ADRs / endpoints / TDD order / files / tests / risks)
Full plan artifact is Arm C's draft (saved to run scratchpad `arm3-fable`); its required sections:
- **Governing ADRs:** ADR-009 (spec-first, 3 gen files, drift gate), ADR-004 (version-history = hours tier; writes no-store), ADR-002 (organizer_id predicate on every new fn), ADR-029 (thin wrapper over `EditSeatMap`; no re-derivation), ADR-022/020 (**no migration** — tables exist).
- **Endpoints:** `POST /seat-maps/{id}/edit` → 201 SeatMap / 409 orphan `{error}` / 404; `GET /public/seat-maps/{id}/versions` → hours tier, `{current_version, versions[]}`; `POST /venues/{id}/ga-capacity` → 200 Venue, no-store. GA read = existing `/public/venues`.
- **New store fns:** `ListSeatMapVersions(seatMapID)` (resolve family, ORDER BY version DESC, select published_at), `UpdateVenueGACapacity(in)` (UPDATE ... WHERE id AND organizer_id RETURNING).
- **TDD order (tests RED first):** (1) spec+regen+compile stubs; (2) FIRST red test `TestEditSeatMapOrphanedPinReturns409` in new `services/catalog/internal/api/seatmap_edit_test.go` (seed→publish→pin→edit-dropping-pinned-seat→assert 409 + exact body); (3) remaining edit/versions/GA handler tests red→green (make fake `EditSeatMap` real, pin-seedable); (4) frontend red: `api.test.ts` orphan-body parse (against today's body-discarding postCatalog); (5) `SeatMapEditor.test.tsx` (jsdom); (6) store-smoke + gateway-smoke last.
- **Files:** catalog: openapi.yaml (+3 paths, +6 schemas), openapi_gen.go (regen), server.go (3 handlers + 2 writeStoreError cases), store.go (+2 iface fns +1 type), postgres.go (+2 impls), new seatmap_edit_test.go, server_test.go (real fake), seatmap_edit_smoke_test.go (extend). web: backoffice api-types.gen.ts (regen) + storefront api-types.gen.ts (regen, mechanical) + api.ts (CatalogApiError + error-body parse + 4 client fns) + new SeatMapEditor.tsx + [id].astro (publish/edit/set-ga actions + GA panel + version panel + error alert) + new vitest.config.ts + api.test.ts (extend) + new SeatMapEditor.test.tsx. smoke: new seatmap_edit_test.go. **No migration. No web/scanner change; no web/storefront/src change beyond the gen file.**
- **Risks:** full-replacement editor (pre-load current geometry so an untouched submit round-trips); edit not idempotent (post/redirect/get + documented publish-re-POST recovery); hours-tier staleness (gateway/SSR uncached in this stack → immediate); regen drift (run check-generate before push); jsdom now applies to api.test.ts (fetch-stubbed pure fns fine; else environmentMatchGlobs); ADR-028 response validator will reject schema-drifting payloads (caught by handler tests).

**The kind=plan drafts as amended above are the plan.** Proceeding to Building (gateless Gate 2).

objective.note: Completes the 'staff can author AND edit a seat map in the back office UI' COS on the UI side: edit a published map, see version history, manage a venue's GA/seated configuration.

scope.note: RESHAPED 2026-07-20 (owner: absorb backend into TKT-105). IN: (backend) new catalog HTTP endpoints exposing the TKT-104 store-only edit path — edit a published map → new version, a version-history read (list a map family's versions + which is published + when), and a venue GA read+update (ga_capacity is write-once today); OpenAPI paths + regenerated types; map ErrSeatMapEditOrphansPinned/ErrSeatIdentityNotFound to HTTP (orphan=409). (UI) back-office to edit a published map (new version via the new endpoint), a version-history view, GA/seated config view+set per venue, and surfacing the pinning-contract rejection as clear UX. OUT: any NEW domain rule (the edit/pin CONTRACT is TKT-104's, unchanged — we surface it via HTTP+UI); no back-office-only backend logic (all new backend lives in catalog).

uncertainties.note: RESHAPED 2026-07-20. Editor UX shape (full-geometry-replacement editor vs incremental) and version-history presentation — frontend design settled in plan/build. Backend endpoint shape (paths, verbs, request bodies) settled in the plan against the existing store signatures; no product/architecture unknown.

dependencies.note: blocked-by TKT-103 (published maps + GA/seated coexistence) and TKT-104 (the store-only safe-edit path + pinning contract this ticket now exposes via HTTP+UI). Both Done/merged. NOTE 2026-07-20: TKT-104 shipped edit/pin as store functions only (ADR-029 §5 — 'no new HTTP endpoint in this ticket; the editing UI is TKT-105'); the HTTP+regen layer is therefore this ticket's, absorbed by owner decision.

approach.note: RESHAPED 2026-07-20. Catalog: add HTTP handlers over the existing store fns (EditSeatMap present; add a ListSeatMapVersions store read and a venue GA update store fn), OpenAPI paths, error mapping (writeStoreError), regenerate Go + TS types (ADR-009, gate-enforced drift). Reads at ADR-004 hours tier (geometry/version), writes never cached. Back-office: extend web/backoffice/src/pages/venues/[id].astro + lib/api.ts (parse the {error} body so a 409 orphan shows a real message); interactive editor is a React component (jsdom vitest harness, copy web/scanner). organizer_id-scoped (ADR-002).

first_slice.note: RESHAPED 2026-07-20. Full-stack vertical: edit endpoint + version-history read + venue-GA read/update in catalog, then the UI that makes author-and-EDIT demonstrable end-to-end, incl. a surfaced pinning-contract rejection (screenshot in PR).

success.note: RESHAPED 2026-07-20. COS: (1) new catalog endpoints — edit published map→new version, version-history read, venue GA read+update — published via OpenAPI with regenerated types and contract/handler tests; orphaning edit returns 409 with the {error} body. (2) staff edit a published map in the UI producing a new version; (3) version history shows which version is published and when; (4) a pinning-contract rejection surfaces a clear actionable error (no silent failure/corruption, screenshot); (5) GA vs seated config is visible and settable per venue; (6) UI verified in a browser; storefront/scanner untouched; make check green.

context_memo.note: Baked: ADR-009 (bind to published contracts, regenerate types), ADR-004 (hours tier reads, catalog-owned history). governingAdrs present.
